description: This file implements the management of extra state associated with Python code objects in PyTorch's Dynamo JIT compiler, including cache management, guard evaluation, and precompile entries.

classes.name: ExtraState
classes.description: Manages cache entries, guard evaluations, and associated metadata for a Python code object.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cached compiled version of a code segment with associated guard and backend info.

classes.name: PrecompileEntry
classes.description: Stores precompile guard manager and code for ahead-of-time compilation.

methods.name: get_first_entry
methods.description: Returns the first cache entry in the list, or nullptr if empty.

methods.name: move_to_front
methods.description: Moves a cache entry to the front of the LRU list.

methods.name: move_to_back
methods.description: Moves a cache entry to the back of the LRU list.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry and moves it to the back of the list.

methods.name: get_extra_state
methods.description: Retrieves the ExtraState associated with a PyCodeObject.

methods.name: set_extra_state
methods.description: Associates an ExtraState with a PyCodeObject.

methods.name: init_and_set_extra_state
methods.description: Creates and sets a new ExtraState for a code object.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Finds a cached code entry matching the current guard conditions.

methods.name: create_cache_entry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry and adds it to the ExtraState.

methods.name: _debug_get_cache_entry_list
methods.description: Returns a list of cache entries for a code object.

methods.name: _reset_precompile_entries
methods.description: Clears all precompile entries for a code object.

methods.name: _load_precompile_entry
methods.description: Adds a precompile entry to a code object.

methods.name: _set_lru_cache
methods.description: Enables or disables LRU cache management.

methods.name: _debug_get_precompile_entries
methods.description: Returns all precompile entries for a code object.
